subgraphs.name: Dials - Pika H3 + De-rope
subgraphs.description: MiniMax H3 + Pika H3 Flex text/image to video with the Dial Rack on the model input. de-rope on adds a second pass that slows the jerky stretches and maps them back to real time (about 4x the time of pass 1); off, that stage does not run. Pass 1's audio is kept. Double-click to open the graph.
